title: The Missing Research Data
overview: On Wednesday morning a university lab discovered that the raw dataset and analysis outputs for Trial X were deleted from the shared server. The manuscript is due Friday.
objective: Determine what happened to the dataset, who was responsible, and whether it was deliberate. Support your conclusion with evidence.

hypotheses.statement: Ken Chen deliberately deleted the dataset to conceal problems in the results.
The deletion was an accidental side effect of the scheduled server migration.
Ken Chen deleted the dataset by accident while cleaning up storage.
Lina Park sabotaged the dataset because of a grudge against the PI.

evidence.title: Incident report
evidence.content: Wednesday 08:10: the folder /data/trial_X and its analysis outputs are missing from the shared server. The manuscript is due Friday. Dr. Rao (PI) asks for an explanation.

evidence.title: IT maintenance notice
evidence.content: A server migration is scheduled for Wednesday 02:00. Users were warned that storage may be briefly unavailable during the window.

evidence.title: Lab roster
evidence.content: Dr. Maya Rao (PI); Ken Chen (postdoc, Trial X analysis lead); Lina Park (graduate student); Sam Ortiz (systems administrator).

evidence.title: Server audit log
evidence.content: Tuesday 23:41: DELETE on /data/trial_X issued by account kchen from a lab workstation. No other directories were modified that night.

evidence.title: Ken Chen's statement
evidence.content: Ken states he was at home sick all Tuesday evening, never used the lab workstation, and did not touch Trial X.

evidence.title: Building badge log
evidence.content: Tuesday 23:20: badge for Ken Chen swiped into the lab building. No badge swipe for Lina Park after 18:05.

evidence.title: Lina Park's statement
evidence.content: Lina says she left the lab at 18:00 on Tuesday and was not on campus that night.

evidence.title: Emails: Lina and the PI
evidence.content: A tense email exchange from last month in which Lina disputes her authorship position on an unrelated paper.

evidence.title: Backup snapshot analysis
evidence.content: The Tuesday 22:00 snapshot was recovered. Only /data/trial_X was removed afterwards. The snapshot shows 14 trials flagged as outliers and the analysis notebook last edited by kchen at 21:50.

evidence.title: Ken Chen's private messages
evidence.content: Tuesday 21:58, Ken to a friend: 'Those 14 outliers won't survive review. Tonight I make the problem go away.'
